content:
[Intro]
[C5]Ooh,
[Fmadd9]Mm,
[Eb6]Mm,
[D11]

[Verse 1]
[C5]I set my sail
[Fmadd9]Fly the wind, it will take me
[Eb6]Back to my home,
[D11]sweet home
[C5]Lie on my back
[Fmadd9]Clouds are making way for me
[Eb6]I'm coming home,
[D11]sweet home

[Chorus]
[Eb6]I see your star
[D11]You left it burning for me
[Eb6]Mother, I'm here
[D11]

[Verse 2]
[C5]Eyes open wide
[Fmadd9]Feel your heart and it's glowing
[Eb6]I'm welcome home,
[D11]sweet home
[C5]I take your hand
[Fmadd9]Now you'll never be lonely
[Eb6]Not when I'm home,
[D11]sweet home

[Chorus]
[Eb6]I see your star
[D11]You left it burning for me
[Eb6]Mother, I'm here
[D11]
